rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides policy-gated vault operations including deposits, redemptions, transfers, and balance checks for AI agent economic actions. Every spend action is bounded by configurable policy rules covering per-transaction limits, daily/weekly/monthly budgets, address allowlists, and time windows. Risky actions escalate to a human review queue rather than auto-approving, maintaining human economic sovereignty over agent behavior.
